profile.campus: MERLIN Bilbao-Arasur Data Center Campus, Rivabellosa, Álava
profile.address: Supermanzana 6, Plataforma Logística Arasur, Avenida Ribera Baja S/N, 01213 Rivabellosa, Álava, Spain
profile.reading: This is the first building of MERLIN Properties Bilbao-Arasur Data Center Campus, at Supermanzana 6, Plataforma Logistica Arasur, Avenida Ribera Baja S/N, in Rivabellosa, Alava, in Spains Basque Country, inaugurated in December 2024. MERLIN Properties, a listed Spanish real estate investment trust (SOCIMI), is developing the site under its MERLIN Edged data center brand as a multi phase campus it says is planned to become Spains largest once fully built, ultimately reaching 300 megawatts of IT power capacity across three development phases, of which this first building represents the initial operational phase. The campus is powered by an on site photovoltaic installation with more than 100 megawatts of capacity and runs on 100 percent renewable energy with water free cooling systems. MERLIN markets Arasur for its position on what it describes as the lowest latency link between Europe and North America, citing proximity to the Marea, Grace Hopper, and Anjana transatlantic submarine cable systems, and maintains secure connections to its other MERLIN Edged facilities in Madrid, Barcelona, and Lisbon. MERLIN Properties was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Madrid, listed on Spains IBEX 35 stock index, with total assets reported at about 12.63 billion euros in 2025. The company built its Iberian commercial real estate portfolio partly through the 2015 acquisition of Testa and the 2016 purchase of Metrovacesas commercial assets, and today operates across office, shopping center, logistics, and, through its MERLIN Edged brand including this Arasur campus, data center segments. Spanish engineering firm KREAN, which provided design and construction management services for the building, describes the structure as nearly 24,000 square meters across three levels, organized into a data hall, administrative space, and a generators area, built on a broader Arasur plot exceeding 150,000 square meters, with infrastructure it says was specifically adapted to the needs of generative AI workloads. KREANs own materials refer to this first building internally as DC3 within MERLINs numbering, distinct from the campus marketing name of building one, and note that the next phase, DC2, was already in planning at the time of that report.
